execution: NH overseas mock account, actual mock fills
fee_basis: 2 USD per contract per side; model assumption, not broker invoice
pnl_basis: Actual mock fill prices minus modeled fees; no extra synthetic slippage deducted
drawdown_basis: Saved live monitor statistic using fresh quotes. Not reconstructed from closed-equity.csv
closed_equity_basis: Completed pair P&L only; excludes floating P&L between exits
competition_score_basis: Run-start ledger; not the organizer's 15:00 equity baseline or rank
exit_reason_limit: Per-fill reason is flatten. Manual requests are recorded separately. Other exact historical exit triggers are not inferred.
